title: Aion: Post your name and class!

posts.author: Mole
posts.title: Aion: Post your name and class!
posts.html:
So as you all know the pre-order customers get a wonderful 48 hour headstart on the competition, me and Pathogen are going to take every advantage of this and power level. I know alot of people have also bought the game so do a quick reply with your desired name and the class your going to play so we can all group up in game 

My name will be Mole If its not taken and I will be playing the Sorcerer branch on the Elyos side.

If possible everybody get on the same server on the same side 

Me and Pathogen already gained level 22 in a level 25 closed beta but obviously thats been wiped however it does mean we know the route for powerleveling 

Alright see you in the game
